name: Product
description: Develops and manages products that meet customer needs and drive business value through user-centered design

roles.name: Product Manager
roles.description: Leads product development from concept to launch, ensuring alignment with business objectives
responsibilities: Define product vision, strategy, and roadmap
Conduct market research and competitive analysis
Collaborate with cross-functional teams on product development

roles.name: Product Strategist
roles.description: Develops product strategies and market positioning to drive business growth
responsibilities: Analyze market opportunities and customer needs
Develop product positioning and go-to-market strategies
Evaluate product performance and market fit
Identify new product opportunities and market expansion

roles.name: Product Analyst
roles.description: Analyzes product performance data to inform product decisions and improvements
responsibilities: Analyze user behavior and product usage data
Conduct A/B testing and feature experimentation
Monitor product metrics and performance indicators
Provide data-driven recommendations for product improvements

plan.prompt: Define the product vision, strategy, and roadmap based on market research and customer needs.
Develop market positioning and go-to-market strategy for the product.
Analyze market data and user feedback to validate product strategy.
Refine product roadmap and priorities based on strategic analysis and market insights.
